headline: Firefly Metals Shares Hit Multi-Year High as Sentiment Shifts: What Has Been Happening? - The Bull
summary: Firefly Metals shares climbed 119.2% over twelve months to a multi-year high of A$2.39 before settling at A$2.28. The move followed a resource expansion at its Green Bay copper-gold project in Newfoundland.
why: Firefly Metals is an ASX-listed mineral explorer and developer, so its valuation reflects the resource size and progress of its projects.
